account.entry: stored first later Bybit BBO after completed decision
account.exit: stored exact structural route; no elapsed-time or scheduled close
account.funding: stored entry funding state applied to any crossed settlement timestamps as a sparse-screen proxy

actions.CASCADE_CONTINUE: raid/liquidation direction to stored same-side structural objective; stored opposite objective invalidates
actions.EXHAUSTION_REJECT: opposite raid direction to stored inside/opposite structural objective; raid-side objective invalidates

chronology.confirmation_gate: development 18/24bp model path >=30 trades, NAV>1, PF>1, median>0 and exact top-five-positive-event deletion/full reroute NAV>1

decision.fail: retire exact information unit without adjacent cluster/window/model/threshold/risk/SMC-gate rescue
decision.pass: sparse information headroom only; broader pre-2024 direct-liquidation source required before any strategy claim

competing_states: forced-order cascade accepted into new price
last forced order absorbed and rejected
logic.information_event: forced position liquidation published by Bybit while a frozen prior completed five-minute executable range boundary is consumed
logic.smc_role: frozen external liquidity and structural objectives define location/invalidation; liquidation messages identify the forced payer; no FVG/OB/MSS Boolean gate

model.policy: highest strictly positive action value per event; one global slot; otherwise flat
model.target: direct 24bp account return of each frozen action

purpose: Fatal pre-2024 screen of exchange-published forced-liquidation inventory at immutable prior-range raid events; continuation/rejection/flat direct account value.

sources.availability_clock: local_timestamp; only messages within raid-second start through completed event decision
sources.coverage_limit: Bybit liquidation feed after November 2021 may be throttled/incomplete; treat as observed published forced-order sample, not full liquidation universe
sources.liquidation_provider: Tardis normalized Bybit downloadable CSV first-day monthly samples
